title: Proper direct image of unbounded complexes
statement:
Use the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], inherited from [sk-lem-proper-heart-bound]: a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p_0>0$ with $p_0\ne\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and $k$-morphisms. All filtered diagrams are small in the fixed universe. Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $\ell$ a prime, $\Qlb$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $E\subseteq\Qlb$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, understood as the condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] or [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], respectively. For $T=X,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ be the unbounded derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda_T$-modules, with cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^n$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$ for the full subcategory of sheaves isomorphic to filtered colimits, in $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$, of constructible sheaves [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and define
$$
\Dic(T,\Lambda)=\{K\in D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda):\mathcal H^n(K)\in\IndCons(T,\Lambda)\text{ for every }n\in\mathbf Z\}.
$$
Let $p:X\to Y$ be proper and let $d\in\mathbf Z$ bound the dimensions of all geometric fibres of $p$, as in [sk-lem-proper-heart-bound]. Let $Rp_*$ denote the total right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of the module pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For integers $a,b$, write $\Dic^{\leq b}(T,\Lambda)$ and $\Dic^{\geq a}(T,\Lambda)$ for the objects of $\Dic(T,\Lambda)$ whose cohomology vanishes in degrees $>b$, respectively $<a$. Use the canonical truncations of [def-kun-truncations]. Then $Rp_*$ maps $\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dic(Y,\Lambda)$, and
$$
Rp_*\bigl(\Dic^{\leq b}(X,\Lambda)\bigr)\subset\Dic^{\leq b+2d+1}(Y,\Lambda),\qquad
Rp_*\bigl(\Dic^{\geq a}(X,\Lambda)\bigr)\subset\Dic^{\geq a}(Y,\Lambda).
$$
Moreover, for $K\in\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ and every $q\in\mathbf Z$, the canonical truncation maps
$K\leftarrow\tau_{\leq q}K\to\tau_{\geq q-2d-1}\tau_{\leq q}K$ induce an isomorphism in $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$
$$
\mathcal H^q(Rp_*K)\simeq\mathcal H^q\bigl(Rp_*\tau_{\geq q-2d-1}\tau_{\leq q}K\bigr).
$$

external.place: An eventually constant tower has vanishing $\varprojlim^1$, so the Milnor sequence of [sk-prop-pe-milnor] gives $$ \mathcal H^q(Rp_*K)\simeq\mathcal H^q(Rp_*\tau_{\geq-n}K)\quad\text{for all sufficiently large }n. $$ The right side is covered by the bounded-below case.

proof.text: Convert the finite-lower-bound formulation of the geometric fibre dimension bound to the form used by [det-proper-unbounded-window-arbitrary]. For any $\delta\in\mathbb N_\infty\cup\{-\infty\}$ satisfying $n\leq\delta\Rightarrow n\leq d$, if $d\geq0$ and $\delta>d$, then $d+1\leq\delta$ contradicts the hypothesis. If $d<0$, any $\delta\ne-\infty$ would admit $0\leq\delta$ and contradict the hypothesis. Thus $\delta\leq d$ for nonnegative $d$ and $\delta=-\infty$ for negative $d$. This is the proved private Lean helper dimensionBound_of_nat_tests.

Its statement already gives $Rp_*K\in\Dic(Y,\Lambda)$ and both amplitude bounds. Select these three clauses and arrange the upper and lower bounds in the order of the present assertion. The named dependency carries the bounded-below spectral-sequence reduction and truncation stability, so these are not repeated in this module.

proof.text: For each integer $q$, apply [det-proper-unbounded-window-iso] with the original finite-lower-bound dimension hypothesis and the same $K$. Its final three clauses give the ind-constructibility of the final window endpoint and invertibility of the images under $H^q Rp_*$ of truncLEι and truncGEπ. These are exactly the remaining three conjuncts of ProperUnboundedWindowAssertions. The two maps and their inverses lie in the full subcategory IndCons, so their inverse-first composite is the specified window isomorphism. Repeat the same selections for the condensed algebraic closure coefficient declaration.

lean.statement: theorem properUnboundedWindow (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ) (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] (d : ℤ) (hd : ∀ (y : Y) (n : ℕ), (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) (AlgebraicClosure (Y.residueField y)))) ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y) : Scheme.{u}) → (n : ℤ) ≤ d) : ProperUnboundedWindowAssertions (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E) p d
